digest.component_or_area: Jira-family shared layer / rebar_reconciler adapters seam
propositions: Jira-family-general units (identity convention, sanitizers, value maps, link vocabulary, probe classifier) currently live in the Cloud-specific adapters/jira/ and were consumed cross-adapter via unsanctioned private imports.
A new adapters/jira_family/ package becomes the sole home for non-location-pinned shared symbols, moved by symbol under public names, with imports re-pointed and no re-export shims left at old paths.

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) must not move because they are loaded by path via spec_from_file_location; they are shared by dependency inversion, importing jira_family contracts rather than the reverse.

classify_probe_response must take the resolved-status set as a required keyword-only parameter (no Cloud-name default) so a self-hosted DC workflow's resolved states are not misclassified as PRESENT_FILTERED.

The duplicated and drifted local→Jira status/priority maps are unified into one definition site, adopting the deliberate observable change deleted→"Done" (replacing the invalid "Deleted" produced by the ACLI .title() fallback).

Behavior is otherwise preserved and enforced by J1's 30 unmodified characterization oracles, a persistent AST-walking import-graph contract, absolute-import-only requirements, and an import-only diff invariant for the ACLI transport.
